annotations.title: Size a hotel or motel loan

description: Runs the motel.loans hotel loan sizer on your numbers: RevPAR, rooms and total revenue, each expense line, NOI, annual debt service, DSCR, the largest loan the cash flow supports at the lender's minimum DSCR, the loan-to-price cap, which one binds, cap rate, price per key and breakeven occupancy. Pick a brand to fill franchise fees from its FDD and a program (SBA 7(a), SBA 504, conventional) to fill rate, amortization and loan-to-price as the calculator does.

adr.description: Average daily rate in dollars, e.g. 89.

amortization_years.description: Amortization in years. Overrides the program term.

brand.description: Franchise brand name or slug (e.g. "Super 8", "comfort-inn") to fill franchise fees from its FDD. Omit for an independent with no franchise fees.

dscr_target.description: Lender's minimum debt service coverage, e.g. 1.25. Default 1.25 (SBA 7(a) hotel acquisition).

franchise_fee_pct.description: Franchise fees as a percent of rooms revenue. Overrides the brand.

franchise_fee_per_room_month.description: Franchise fees per room per month in dollars. Overrides the brand.

insurance.description: Insurance, dollars a year. Default 0: pass the real figure or NOI is overstated.

loan.description: Loan requested in dollars. Default: price times the maximum loan-to-price.

management_pct.description: Management fee as a percent of total revenue. Default 0 (owner-operated).

max_ltv_pct.description: Lender's maximum loan to price or value, percent. Overrides the program.

opex_pct.description: Operating costs as a percent of total revenue, excluding franchise fees, management, taxes, insurance and reserve. Default 56 (the calculator example; use the trailing-12 P&L).

other_revenue_pct.description: Other revenue as a percent of rooms revenue (vending, pet fees, meeting room). Default 2.

price.description: Purchase price or value in dollars, e.g. 3200000.

program.description: Fills rate, amortization and maximum loan-to-price the way the calculator's program buttons do. Default sba_7a.

property_taxes.description: Property taxes, dollars a year. Default 0: pass the real figure or NOI is overstated.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate, percent. Overrides the program rate.

reserve_pct.description: FF&E reserve as a percent of total revenue. Default 4.

name: size_hotel_loan
title: Size a hotel or motel loan
